units.source_text: “容貌似舅，潘安仁之外甥；气调如兄，崔季珪之小妹。”

en.t: “Her looks resemble her uncle, like Pan Anren’s nephew; her bearing is like her brother’s, like Cui Jigui’s little sister.”

units.source_text: 亦《游仙窟》中句，是十娘的侍女描写十娘的相貌。

en.t: This too is a line from Youxian ku, in which Shiniang’s maid describes Shiniang’s appearance.

units.source_text: 中将君引用此典，意思是说：匂亲王乃大公主之弟，你要看大公主，只要看匂亲王，但他不在这里。

en.t: When Chujo no Kimi quoted this allusion, she meant that Prince Niou was the elder princess’s younger brother, so if one wanted to see the elder princess, one need only look at Prince Niou, though he was not there.

units.source_text: 薰大将引用此典，意思是说：我是大公主之母舅，故不妨亲见大公主。

en.t: When General Kaoru quoted the same allusion, he meant that he was the elder princess’s maternal uncle, and therefore there was no harm in his seeing her in person.
